text: Please put me down, please put me down We're civilizations advanced light years ahead And our consciousness is something we could never comprehend But our basic genetics are essentially the same Which is why our discovery's so important to the race At first they just observed us living in our habitats But then they started taking us as guinea pigs and lab rats Giving us silly names like Cinnamon and Flapjack And stripping us of any of the dignity we had left
